intent:
The audit skill's test run on this repository (plugin/skills/audit/evals/) found three kinds of drift in `.okf/decisions/`:

- ADR 0002 says the briefing tells the agent which skill to use. `ROUTING` in `src/kmctl/briefing.py` names folders and verbs but no skill. The briefing names each kmctl skill (`/handoff`, `/continue`, `write-docs`, `audit`) with when to use it, and stays inside the I3 word budget.
- All nine records carry `decision_status` and `decided_on` in their front matter. Neither is an OKF v0.2 field and no ADR allows them, against ADR 0009 and I4. Each record's body already says the same in its `- Status:` and `- Date:` lines, so the two fields are removed. The `supersede.py` docstring stops naming `decision_status`.
- Records 0001 to 0006 and 0008 have no Consequences section, which `.claude/rules/okf-bundle.md` asks for. Records are not rewritten, so each gains an appended `## Correction, 2026-10-15` section holding its consequences, with a log line.

Done when a test fails on any front matter key in the repository's own `.okf/` that `ALLOWED_FIELDS` lacks, a test fails when every decision record does not have a Consequences heading (its own or in a Correction), a briefing test fails when a kmctl skill is not named, the I3 budget test still passes, and the okf validator passes in strict mode.

# adr-audit-fixes

Relayed from: none

## Intent

The audit skill's test run on this repository (plugin/skills/audit/evals/) found three kinds of drift in `.okf/decisions/`:

- ADR 0002 says the briefing tells the agent which skill to use. `ROUTING` in `src/kmctl/briefing.py` names folders and verbs but no skill. The briefing names each kmctl skill (`/handoff`, `/continue`, `write-docs`, `audit`) with when to use it, and stays inside the I3 word budget.
- All nine records carry `decision_status` and `decided_on` in their front matter. Neither is an OKF v0.2 field and no ADR allows them, against ADR 0009 and I4. Each record's body already says the same in its `- Status:` and `- Date:` lines, so the two fields are removed. The `supersede.py` docstring stops naming `decision_status`.
- Records 0001 to 0006 and 0008 have no Consequences section, which `.claude/rules/okf-bundle.md` asks for. Records are not rewritten, so each gains an appended `## Correction, 2026-10-15` section holding its consequences, with a log line.

Done when a test fails on any front matter key in the repository's own `.okf/` that `ALLOWED_FIELDS` lacks, a test fails when every decision record does not have a Consequences heading (its own or in a Correction), a briefing test fails when a kmctl skill is not named, the I3 budget test still passes, and the okf validator passes in strict mode.

- none
